A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''commandant''' served in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] affiliated [[Parshoone Sector Service Academy]]. During one of his years serving there, [[Isila Drutch]], a student, rose to the top of her class. The [[Commander/Legends|commandant]] offered to sponsor her so she could go to the [[Raithal Academy/Legends|Raithal Academy]], but instead sponsored her to go to [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]] after Drutch asked to go there instead.
